Bancor is a decentralized exchange protocol on Ethereum that operates as an automated market maker. Bancor uses liquidity pools to enable token-to-token conversions without order books. Bancor has a native token called BNT.

Pickle Finance is a yield optimizer protocol that runs on Ethereum. Pickle Finance organizes its yield strategies into vaults called jars. Pickle Finance has a governance token called PICKLE.

BadgerDAO is a decentralized autonomous organization that governs yield products for Bitcoin holders. BadgerDAO is governed through its BADGER token. BadgerDAO operates vaults that deploy wrapped Bitcoin into yield strategies on Ethereum.

Maple Finance is a decentralized credit protocol built on Ethereum. Maple Finance facilitates lending to institutional borrowers through liquidity pools. Maple Finance has a governance token called MPL.
